questions.question_english: 87. What term is used to describe a prolonged period of sluggish economic activity accompanied by low interest rates and low inflation, leading to ineffective monetary policy stimulus?
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'Liquidity Trap'. A liquidity trap occurs when interest rates are low and savings rates are high, making monetary policy ineffective. In such situations, consumers and businesses prefer to hold onto cash rather than invest or spend, leading to stagnant economic growth despite low interest rates. This phenomenon complicates efforts by central banks to stimulate the economy through traditional monetary policy tools.

key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Liquidity Trap
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A liquidity trap occurs when interest rates are low and savings rates are high.

financial savings, resulting in increased interest rates and

phenomenon referred to as?
questions.explanation_english: The phenomenon referred to as the 'Crowding-out Effect' occurs when high levels of government borrowing lead to a reduction in private sector investment. This happens because government borrowing absorbs available financial resources, causing interest rates to rise. As a result, private investors may find it more expensive to borrow money, leading to decreased investment in the economy. This effect can hinder economic growth as private sector investment is crucial for innovation and expansion.

questions.question_english: 97. Identify the INCORRECT statement regarding constitutional provisions on official languages in India:
options_english: Article 343 states that the official language of the Union shall be Hindi written in Devanagari script
Article 345 prohibits State Legislatures from adopting non-Hindi languages for official State purposes
The Eighth Schedule of the Constitution of India currently contains twenty-two officially recognized languages
Article 348 specifically relates to the official language to be used in the Supreme Court and High Courts
questions.explanation_english: Article 345 does not prohibit State Legislatures from adopting non-Hindi languages for official purposes. In fact, it allows states to choose their own official languages, which can include languages other than Hindi. This flexibility is crucial for accommodating the linguistic diversity of India.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। अनुच्छेद 345 राज्य विधानसभाओं को आधिकारिक उद्देश्यों के लिए गैर-हिंदी भाषाओं को अपनाने से नहीं रोकता है। वास्तव में, यह राज्यों को अपनी आधिकारिक भाषाएँ चुनने की अनुमति देता है, जिसमें हिंदी के अलावा अन्य भाषाएँ भी शामिल हो सकती हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Article 345 prohibits State Legislatures from adopting non-Hindi languages for official State purposes
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Article 345 does not prohibit State Legislatures from adopting non-Hindi languages for official purposes.

questions.question_english: 84. Which of the following is the correct pair regarding economic surveys and reports?
options_english: Global Economic Prospects - Reserve Bank of India
Human Development Report - World Trade Organization
Economic Survey of India - Ministry of Finance
questions.explanation_english: The Economic Survey of India is an official publication prepared annually by the Economic Division of the Department of Economic Affairs within the Ministry of Finance. It provides a comprehensive analysis of the national economy over the preceding financial year, highlighting macroeconomic performance, sectoral developments, and economic challenges ahead of the presentation of the Union Budget.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। आर्थिक सर्वेक्षण भारत सरकार के वित्त मंत्रालय के आर्थिक मामलों के विभाग द्वारा वार्षिक रूप से तैयार की जाने वाली एक आधिकारिक प्रकाशन है। यह पिछले वित्तीय वर्ष के दौरान राष्ट्रीय अर्थव्यवस्था का एक व्यापक विश्लेषण प्रदान करता है, जिसमें मैक्रोइकोनॉमिक प्रदर्शन, क्षेत्रीय विकास और संघीय बजट की प्रस्तुति से पहले आर्थिक चुनौतियों को उजागर किया जाता है।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Economic Survey of India is an official publication prepared annually by the Economic Division of the Department of Economic Affairs within the Ministry of Finance.
